parameters.eqs:
dv/dt = (v_0 - v + g) / t_mbr : volt (unless refractory)
dg/dt = -g / tau               : volt (unless refractory) 
rfc                            : second

protocol.reset: restore identical naive network state before each trial; seed Brian2 with the stated seed; zero refractory period on stimulated neurons only, as upstream poi() does
protocol.conditions: P9 bilateral 150 Hz plus sugar 150 Hz and bitter 0,50,100,150,200 Hz; P9-only baseline 150 Hz
